# NeatEditor 1.0.32
### Fixed
- Stopped an iCloud Drive file-observation loop that repeatedly reconciled attribute-only events, causing growing memory use and background CPU during long editing sessions. - Document observation still reloads direct writes, atomic replacements and coordinated external saves; metadata-only changes no longer trigger unnecessary rereads.
### 简体中文
- 修复 iCloud Drive 文件观察循环：纯属性事件不再反复触发协调读取，避免长时间编辑时内存持续增长和后台空转。 - 直接写入、原子替换及其他程序协调保存仍会正常刷新，只有元数据变化不再造成无意义重读。

# NeatEditor 1.0.31
### Fixed
- Dragging the window from the whole top region follows the pointer again: the band uses AppKit's native window drag instead of moving the frame per event, so it no longer stalls, jitters or lags behind the pointer. - Blank double-click keeps the system zoom or minimize preference, clicking the top region focuses the window, and both upper corners resize again. - Tabs still separate a click from a drag at four points, and the buttons, rename field and context menus keep their own events.
### 简体中文
- 顶部整片区域拖动窗口恢复跟手：改由 AppKit 原生窗口拖动处理，不再逐帧设置窗口位置，因此不再卡顿、抖动或落后于指针。 - 空白处双击仍按系统偏好缩放或最小化，点击顶部会聚焦窗口，两个上角也能缩放。 - 标签依然以 4 点为界区分点击与拖动，按钮、重命名输入框和右键菜单保持各自行为。

# NeatEditor 1.0.30
### Changed
- Menus and settings choices show icon and label together: the application commands, sidebar and document context menus, the three settings pickers and the update actions. macOS 27 hides menu symbols by default, so each item asks for its icon explicitly.
### Fixed
- Dragging the window works from the whole top region again, including the sidebar column above the file list and the gutter above the tabs. Buttons, tabs, rename fields and context menus keep their own clicks, and blank double-clicks still follow the system zoom or minimize preference. - Documents refresh in the editor after another program saves a change to the same file, instead of showing stale text until the tab is switched.
### 简体中文
- 菜单和设置选项统一使用图标加文字：应用菜单、侧栏与文档右键菜单、三个设置选择项以及更新操作都显示对应图标。macOS 27 默认隐藏菜单图标，因此每一项都显式声明显示。 - 窗口顶部整片区域都能拖动窗口，包括侧栏文件列表上方和标签上方的空白；按钮、标签、重命名输入框和右键菜单保持各自行为，空白处双击仍按系统偏好缩放或最小化。 - 其他程序保存对同一文件的修改后，编辑器会刷新内容，不再停留在旧文本直到切换标签。

# NeatEditor 1.0.29
### Added
- Warm and White / Black editor themes, with a close button revealed when hovering over a document tab.
### Changed
- Regular-expression search uses the system ICU syntax and can stop long-running or superseded matching.
### Fixed
- Find Next can reach matches beyond the 2,000-highlight painting budget. - File duplication retains coordinated reads and can use exclusive rename when hard links are unavailable. Unsupported exclusive operations fail safely without overwriting another file. - Renaming a document no longer overwrites a different file created concurrently at the destination. - CRLF edits keep line numbers consistent, and deferred external changes are not recorded as applied before reaching the editor.
### 简体中文
- 新增暖色和纯白 / 纯黑编辑器主题，鼠标悬停文档标签时显示关闭按钮。 - 正则搜索改用系统 ICU 语法，可停止耗时或已过时的匹配计算。 - “查找下一处”不再受 2,000 处高亮绘制上限限制。 - 文件复制保留协调读取；硬链接不可用时可使用原子独占重命名。不支持安全发布操作时保留其他文件并报错，不会覆盖。 - 重命名文档时，不再覆盖刚被其他程序创建的同名文件。 - 修复 CRLF 编辑后的行号一致性，以及外部内容尚未应用到编辑器时被提前记录为已同步的问题。

# NeatEditor 1.0.28
### Changed
- App icon is now the yellow pencil on electric blue from WriteDown (owner-directed move; WriteDown will adopt a different mark later).
### 简体中文
- 应用图标换成 WriteDown 现用的黄铅笔电光蓝底（owner 决定转给 NeatEditor；WriteDown 后续再换）。

# NeatEditor 1.0.27
### Changed
- Clearer app icon at small sizes: the typewriter's roller is now silver so it no longer disappears into the dark background, the sheet is a shorter warm ivory that no longer outshines the typewriter, the whole mark is visually centred, and contrast is slightly higher.
### 简体中文
- 应用图标在小尺寸下更清楚：打字机滚轴改为银色，不再融进深色背景；纸张改为更短的暖象牙色，不再压过打字机本身；整体视觉居中，对比度略有提高。

# NeatEditor 1.0.26
### Changed
- New app icon: a jade-green glass typewriter on a dark background, shipped as a layered Icon Composer icon for macOS 26 with the classic icon set kept for older surfaces. - The sidebar lists documents by modification date, newest first.
### Fixed
- Edits made to the same document from another app or device are no longer lost: independent changes merge, and overlapping changes keep both versions side by side instead of overwriting one. - Saves to the same document are applied in order, so a slower earlier save can no longer replace newer text. - File rows refresh after a document is moved or renamed outside NeatEditor. - The floating character count no longer clips the bottom of the editor, and the last lines keep their normal bottom padding.
### 简体中文
- 新应用图标：深色背景上的翡翠绿玻璃打字机；在 macOS 26 上使用 Icon Composer 分层图标，并保留传统图标集供旧界面使用。 - 侧边栏文档改为按修改时间排列，最新的在最前。 - 在其他应用或其他设备上同时修改同一文档时不再丢稿：互不冲突的改动自动合并，重叠的改动会把两个版本并排保留，而不是互相覆盖。 - 同一文档的多次保存按顺序落盘，较慢的旧保存不会再覆盖较新的内容。 - 文档在 NeatEditor 之外被移动或改名后，文件列表会及时刷新。 - 浮动字数统计不再遮住编辑区底部，最后几行恢复正常的底部留白。

# NeatEditor 1.0.25
## 1.0.25 - 2026-10-29
### Changed
- Faster typing in large documents: line numbers now update incrementally instead of rescanning the whole file on every keystroke. - Faster folder listing: sorting no longer re-reads file names on every comparison. - Faster, lighter saving: blank checks no longer copy the document, first-save naming reuses its formatter, and automatic saving writes in the background while manual saves keep their immediate behavior. - Large files (over 2 MB) load through memory mapping; smaller files keep the faster direct read. - Update checks now start after the first window appears instead of during launch.
### 简体中文
- 大文档输入更快：行号改为增量更新，不再每次击键都全量扫描。 - 文件夹列表更快：排序不再每次比较都重复读取文件名。 - 保存更快更轻：空白检查不再复制全文，首次命名复用日期格式器，自动保存改为后台写入，手动保存仍保持即时行为。 - 大文件（超过 2 MB）走内存映射加载，小文件保持更快的直接读取。 - 更新检查改为首个窗口出现后启动，不再占用启动路径。

# NeatEditor 1.0.24
### Changed
- Give the sidebar the same color as the tab bar, including the margins around it, so only the editor uses the light background.
### 简体中文
- 侧边栏（包括周围边距）改为与标签栏相同的颜色，只有编辑区使用浅色背景。

# NeatEditor 1.0.23
### Fixed
- Restore double-click to zoom and drag on the empty top row above the sidebar and beside the window controls, which stopped working in 1.0.21. - Keep the whole top row in the tab bar color without the white area that appeared above the sidebar in 1.0.19 and 1.0.20. - Use the light editor color for everything below the tab bar line, including the margins around the sidebar.
### 简体中文
- 恢复侧边栏上方以及红绿灯按钮旁边空白处的双击缩放和拖动，该功能在 1.0.21 中失效。 - 顶部整行保持标签栏颜色，不再出现 1.0.19、1.0.20 中侧边栏上方的白色区域。 - 标签栏线条以下统一使用编辑区的浅色，包括侧边栏周围的边距。

# NeatEditor 1.0.14
### Fixed
- The native Sidebar toolbar button no longer draws a blue focus ring after accessibility or keyboard activation. Rounded stepped tabs, the continuous editor join, folder selection and window dragging are unchanged.
### 简体中文
- 修复通过辅助功能或键盘激活原生侧边栏按钮后出现蓝色焦点圈的问题；保留圆角台阶标签、连续底边、文件夹切换及拖窗优化。

# NeatEditor 1.0.13
### Fixed
- The selected tab's outline now meets the editor's top rule on the same line, so the tab bar border stays continuous instead of breaking at the tab's bottom corners. - The tab join is measured from AppKit window frames, so the line stays aligned when the sidebar is shown, hidden, or resized.
### 简体中文
- 选中标签的轮廓与编辑区顶线落在同一条线上，标签栏边框不再在标签底部两角断开。 - 标签开口改用 AppKit 窗口坐标换算，侧边栏显示、隐藏或拖动宽度时仍保持对齐。

# NeatEditor 1.0.12
### Changed
- The sidebar lists your `~/Documents` folder by default and can switch to another folder from its header. New documents save to the current folder, and the choice is remembered across launches. - Files without an extension are listed when their head looks like plain UTF-8 text, so extensionless notes appear while binaries are still skipped. - Sidebar rows no longer draw a file icon, giving filenames and previews the full width of the narrow sidebar. - The toolbar's tab strip and the editor share one continuous top rule that opens under the selected tab, keeping the tab attached to the page.
### Fixed
- Documents left in the previous app library (`~/.config/neateditor/documents`) are copied into the current folder once, without overwriting or deleting anything.
### 简体中文
- 侧边栏默认列出你的 `~/Documents`，可在头部切换到其它文件夹；新文档保存到当前文件夹，选择会在重启后保留。 - 无扩展名文件在开头内容像 UTF-8 纯文本时会显示，因此无扩展名笔记也能列出，二进制文件仍然跳过。 - 侧边栏行不再显示文件图标，文件名和摘要可使用窄栏的全部宽度。 - 工具栏下的标签栏与编辑区共用一条连续顶线，并在选中标签处留出开口，让标签与页面保持相连。 - 旧应用目录（`~/.config/neateditor/documents`）中的文档会一次性复制到当前文件夹，不覆盖、不删除任何文件。

# NeatEditor 1.0.9
### Changed
- Remove Text Softness and its three sliders from Settings. Existing document appearance is preserved. - Reduce the Settings content minimum to 500 × 440 points; all remaining controls fit without scrolling.
### 简体中文
- 从设置中移除文字柔和度及其三个滑块，保留现有文档显示效果。 - 设置内容最小尺寸缩小为 500 × 440 点，剩余控件完整可见，无需滚动。

# NeatEditor 1.0.8
## 1.0.8 - 2026-10-18
### Changed
- Settings uses a compact native grouped form with aligned controls, switches and app information. It remains a workspace tab. - Adjust text softness for light, dark and high-contrast appearances with native percentage sliders; existing preferences and immediate application are preserved. - Settings has a 500 × 600 point content minimum so all controls remain visible in smaller windows.
### 简体中文
- 设置改为紧凑的原生分组表单，统一对齐控件、开关和应用信息，继续保留在工作区标签中。 - 浅色、深色和高对比度外观的文字柔和度可用系统滑块按百分比调整，沿用现有偏好并即时生效。 - 设置的内容最小尺寸为 500 × 600 点，较小的窗口也能完整显示全部控件。

# NeatEditor 1.0.7
- Update package is Sparkle EdDSA-signed, Developer ID-signed and notarized by Apple. - 更新包经过 Sparkle EdDSA 签名、Developer ID 签名与苹果公证。

# NeatEditor 1.0.6
- Update package is Sparkle EdDSA-signed, Developer ID-signed and notarized by Apple. - 更新包经过 Sparkle EdDSA 签名、Developer ID 签名与苹果公证。

# NeatEditor 1.0.5
- Update package is Sparkle EdDSA-signed, Developer ID-signed and notarized by Apple. - 更新包经过 Sparkle EdDSA 签名、Developer ID 签名与苹果公证。

# NeatEditor 1.0.1
- 更新包经过 Sparkle EdDSA 签名、Developer ID 签名与苹果公证。
